source_text.slice: REQ-519 slice 2e-a (GH #2535): mode read under lock A, reconcile_binding!/3 result type, mode-aware low-level writers, BindingWriters registry, scope_required refusal and binding.refused, NO-ROW reporting for role_registry, TAM, Backfill, seeding, docs/roles.md remedy. Tests only; nothing under lib/ or priv/ was changed; nothing committed.

task.description: Write the test spec and test code for REQ-519 slice 2e-a (design r2a section 1 2e-a rows, tests T-B/T-R/T-N/T-C/T-L/T-I/T-A, mutants assigned to 2e-a), REQ-519 ACs 1, 5, 6 and the binding.refused half of 7, the SEC code-gate (step-06) MERGE CONDITIONS F-1, F-2 and C-2, and the REVIEWER (step-07) notes. Per-file runs only under the shared mixlock; no mix letflow.check.test, no full or multi-partition suite; mutants applied in memory only.

result.summary: 116 new tests in 7 new files plus one support module, ALL GREEN, run per file, one mix at a time under the mixlock (MIX_ENV=test): binding_writers_modes 50, binding_refusal 10, binding_no_row_report 16, binding_writers_scan 15, enforced_writers_lock 18, enforced_writers_invariant 5 (1 property), enforced_audit_actions 2; the seven files together before the last addition: 115 passed in 96 s, the lock file alone afterwards: 18 passed. mix format applied to every new file. 31 mutants measured in memory: 31 killed (MU-1 is proven by seeded-source scanner tests, not by an in-memory mutant). One mutant (MU-48c) first SURVIVED because the inner repair read the mode again; a test (T-L7f) was added and it is now killed. NOT RUN by instruction: mix letflow.check.test, full or multi-partition suites. No implementation bug found.
result.tests_run_scope: per file, one mix at a time under C:\Users\tvolo\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\mixlock (taken per run with mkdir, released with rmdir by the same script; another session's lock (owner ELIXIR-DEV-2747) was waited for, never removed); no full-suite and no multi-partition run; no mix letflow.check.test. The warnings-as-errors dead-default check of mix letflow.check.test was NOT run; by inspection no helper added in this step has a default argument (the one candidate, tenant!/2, was written without one).

mutants.summary: 31 mutants: 31 killed, 0 survive (MU-48c survived once and was killed after T-L7f was added). MU-1 (a new unregistered call site) is proven live by the seeded-source tests of the scanner (unregistered call found and the comparison fails; a stale row reported; a dropped row makes the real site unregistered), not by an in-memory mutant, because the scan reads lib/ from disk.
mutants.not_measured: the binding_policy and lenient-key text scans and the T-C1 scan of real lib/ read from disk, so an in-memory mutant cannot reach them; their liveness is the seeded-source tests and the HTTP injection test.

implementation_findings: NO IMPLEMENTATION BUG FOUND: every test is green against the working tree and every mutant is killed.

OBS-1: Backfill.run_tenant reads the mode at the sweep level AND the inner repair_group_row! reads it again, so the sweep-level read is only observable for a tenant with no gap; T-L7f pins it. Not a defect.

OBS-2: a Backfill mutant that halts the sweep (MU-43, MU-X6) leaves the following tests of the same file running into the 500 s bound in this harness; irrelevant for the shipped code, noted for anyone re-running mutants.
OBS-3 (environment): the scratchpad directory is shared with earlier sessions; mut.exs, muts_defs.exs, runmut.sh and mixrun.sh in it were (over)written by this step.

OBS-4: AC 6's flip cannot be driven through ScopeEnforcement.flip/4 (on is unsettable until 2f); T-L2/T-L3 use a transaction that does flip/4's core (lock A, read the facts, set the stored mode) with a real held lock A. 2f-b's end-to-end suite should repeat the pair through the real flip.
